import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species case variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.capitalize()
    # Fix island whitespace variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Fix body mass out of range (though not strictly needed for this specific question)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins per island
    counts = df['island'].value_counts()
    return counts.to_dict()
